ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: According to a report by Taiwan's United Daily News, Japan's Tokyo Shimbun reported on August 2, 2013 that Japan planned to dispatch the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force to be stationed on Yonaguni Island on the southwesternmost side, and Japan's Ministry of Defense subsequently confirmed this report. The report said (as shown in the figure) that Yonaguni Island is only 110 kilometers from Hualien County in the Taiwan region, 150 kilometers from the Diaoyu Islands, and 500 kilometers from Okinawa, where Japan currently has troops stationed. It is Japan's southwesternmost gateway, has only 1600 residents, and Japan had not stationed troops there in the past. Answer the following question based on this. <image1> If a fighter jet departs from Yonaguni Island at local time 8:00 at a speed of about 1540 km per hour and can arrive in Shanghai, China (31°N, 120°E) after 30 min, and if the Beijing time when it arrives in Shanghai is 8:18, then what are the approximate longitude and latitude of Yonaguni Island?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a “schematic map of the location of Yonaguni Island.” It can be seen that Yonaguni Island is located east of China’s Taiwan Island and near the Hualien area of Taiwan. The figure marks that it is about 110 kilometers from Hualien, about 150 kilometers from the Diaoyu Islands, and about 500 kilometers from Okinawa. Combining this with the fact that Shanghai is located on the eastern coast of China and at latitude 31°N, it can be judged that Yonaguni Island should be farther south than Shanghai and located to the east. Then reason: The fighter jet departs from Yonaguni Island at local time 8:00 and arrives in Shanghai after flying for 30 min; when it arrives in Shanghai, Beijing time is 8:18, so the Beijing time at takeoff was 8:18－30 min＝7:48. The local time on Yonaguni Island, 8:00, is 12 min earlier than Beijing time 7:48. For every 1° difference in longitude, local time differs by about 4 min, so Yonaguni Island is 12÷4＝3° east of the 120°E where Beijing time is based, and its longitude is about 123°E. The flight distance is 1540 km/h × 0.5 h＝770 km. Shanghai is at 31°N, 120°E, and Yonaguni Island’s longitude is about 123°E, so the east-west longitude difference is about 3°. Near 25°—31°N, 1° of longitude is about 111×cos latitude, about 96—100 km, so the east-west distance is about 290—300 km. Then the north-south distance is about sqrt(770²－300²)≈710 km, which converted to latitude difference is about 710÷111≈6—7°. The figure shows that Yonaguni Island is south of Shanghai, so the latitude is about 31°N－7°≈24°N. Therefore, the longitude and latitude of Yonaguni Island are about 24°N, 123°E.

If a fighter jet departs from Yonaguni Island at local time 8:00 at a speed of about 1540 km per hour and can arrive in Shanghai, China (31°N, 120°E) after 30 min, and if the Beijing time when it arrives in Shanghai is 8:18, then what are the approximate longitude and latitude of Yonaguni Island?

method.method_draft: Read the image first to establish that 与那国岛 lies southeast of mainland China and near Taiwan, so it should be south of Shanghai and east of 120°E. From the text, the plane leaves the island at local time 8:00 and flies 30 min, while arrival in Shanghai is Beijing time 8:18; therefore departure in Beijing time was 7:48. The island local time is 12 minutes ahead of Beijing time, so it is 12/4 = 3° east of 120°E, giving longitude about 123°E. The flight distance is 1540 × 0.5 = 770 km. Shanghai is at 31°N, 120°E; the 3° longitude gap near this latitude is about 3 × 111 × cos(roughly 25°–30°) ≈ 290–300 km. The north-south gap is then approximately sqrt(770² − 300²) ≈ 710 km, or about 6–7° of latitude. Since the map places the island south of Shanghai, latitude is about 31° − 7° ≈ 24°N. Conclude about 24°N, 123°E.

raw_record.original_question:
据台湾《联合报》报道，日本《东京新闻》2013年8月2日报道称日本计划派遣日本陆上自卫队进驻最西南侧的与那国岛，日本防卫省随后证实了此报道。报道称（如图所示），与那国岛距台湾地区的花莲县只有110公里，距钓鱼岛150公里，距日本现在驻军的冲绳却有500公里，是日本最西南侧的门户，居民只有1600人，日本过去并未在此驻军。据此回答下题。

<image1>

若有一战斗机于当地时间8:00以每小时大约1540 km的速度从与那国岛出发，30 min后即可抵达我国上海（31°N，120°E）。若抵达上海时的北京时间为8:18，则与那国岛的经纬度约为多少？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The figure is a “schematic map of the location of Yonaguni Island.” It can be seen that Yonaguni Island is located east of China’s Taiwan Island and near the Hualien area of Taiwan. The figure marks that it is about 110 kilometers from Hualien, about 150 kilometers from the Diaoyu Islands, and about 500 kilometers from Okinawa. Combining this with the fact that Shanghai is located on the eastern coast of China and at latitude 31°N, it can be judged that Yonaguni Island should be farther south than Shanghai and located to the east.

Then reason: The fighter jet departs from Yonaguni Island at local time 8:00 and arrives in Shanghai after flying for 30 min; when it arrives in Shanghai, Beijing time is 8:18, so the Beijing time at takeoff was 8:18－30 min＝7:48. The local time on Yonaguni Island, 8:00, is 12 min earlier than Beijing time 7:48. For every 1° difference in longitude, local time differs by about 4 min, so Yonaguni Island is 12÷4＝3° east of the 120°E where Beijing time is based, and its longitude is about 123°E.

The flight distance is 1540 km/h × 0.5 h＝770 km. Shanghai is at 31°N, 120°E, and Yonaguni Island’s longitude is about 123°E, so the east-west longitude difference is about 3°. Near 25°—31°N, 1° of longitude is about 111×cos latitude, about 96—100 km, so the east-west distance is about 290—300 km. Then the north-south distance is about sqrt(770²－300²)≈710 km, which converted to latitude difference is about 710÷111≈6—7°. The figure shows that Yonaguni Island is south of Shanghai, so the latitude is about 31°N－7°≈24°N.

Therefore, the longitude and latitude of Yonaguni Island are about 24°N, 123°E.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
According to a report by Taiwan's United Daily News, Japan's Tokyo Shimbun reported on August 2, 2013 that Japan planned to dispatch the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force to be stationed on Yonaguni Island on the southwesternmost side, and Japan's Ministry of Defense subsequently confirmed this report. The report said (as shown in the figure) that Yonaguni Island is only 110 kilometers from Hualien County in the Taiwan region, 150 kilometers from the Diaoyu Islands, and 500 kilometers from Okinawa, where Japan currently has troops stationed. It is Japan's southwesternmost gateway, has only 1600 residents, and Japan had not stationed troops there in the past. Answer the following question based on this.

<image1>

If a fighter jet departs from Yonaguni Island at local time 8:00 at a speed of about 1540 km per hour and can arrive in Shanghai, China (31°N, 120°E) after 30 min, and if the Beijing time when it arrives in Shanghai is 8:18, then what are the approximate longitude and latitude of Yonaguni Island?
